Players Committee errata sheet slip of [[Bow To The First Order (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Deploy on table. Once per game, may take Finalizer into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per character, when you deploy Hux, Kylo, Phasma, or Snoke to an [Episode VII] battleground, may take any one card into hand from Used Pile; reshuffle. [Immune to Alter.]”

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/errata_122021.pdf#page=1 errata_122021.pdf], page 1 (PDF dated 21 December 2021, “Official text as of December 18, 2021”). Rendered from the PDF at 300 dpi and cropped to the slip with its title label; no other edits.
